description: PM service, Workers edition (component A of #9078, under #9079): the hosted edition of the pm-stack PM service. Slice 1 (#12825): PM tenant store schema + migrations. Slice 2 (#12826): hosted collector — registry-driven multi-board ingest with IngestDO cursors. Slice 3 (#12828): hosted read API parity — projects/item/roadmap/releases per #9060 §6, served from the tenant DB. Slice 4 (#12829): dashboard pages — boards, item genealogy, roadmap + priorities, releases, needs-attention.
name: pm-service
